name: dompurify
notes: Browser-first DOM sanitizer. Dual MPL-2.0/Apache-2.0; choose Apache-2.0. Publishes SLSA provenance and Sigstore signatures on GitHub release artifacts, but npm tarballs carry no provenance. 11.7 KB gzip.
provenance_note: SLSA v1 attestation and Sigstore signatures are attached to GitHub release artifacts. The four dist files shipped in the npm tarball (purify.js, purify.min.js, purify.cjs.js, purify.es.mjs) are byte-identical to the attested SHA-256 subjects, but the npm tarball itself is unattested.

build_vs_buy.effort: do not build; years of adversarial testing
build_vs_buy.rationale: Never build a sanitizer. The bypass corpus and the 33-advisory history are the product.
